def optional_list_rows(flow, rows, condition):
    meta = flow.metadata
    [(meta := {}) for _ in rows]
    meta["sandbox_run_id"] = "run-1"


def optional_set_rows(flow, rows, condition):
    meta = flow.metadata
    {((meta := {}), 0)[1] for _ in rows}
    meta["sandbox_run_id"] = "run-1"


def optional_dict_rows(flow, rows, condition):
    meta = flow.metadata
    {0: (meta := {}) for _ in rows}
    meta["sandbox_run_id"] = "run-1"

async def empty_async_rows(rows):
    for row in rows:
        yield row


async def optional_async_rows(flow, rows, condition):
    meta = flow.metadata
    [(meta := {}) async for _ in empty_async_rows(rows)]
    meta["sandbox_run_id"] = "run-1"
